This is a vault-tier demo document used by the Phase 3 E2E integration
harness. It carries two tags so its slug surfaces on `/tags/demo/` and
`/tags/integration/`.

The body is intentionally short so the slim contentIndex transform
emits a snippet ≤ 240 chars — exactly what the search popover lazy-
fetches.
